input_menu.base: two-circle flat-character menu over K=RP3 x S1
input_menu.fiber_requirement: one compact connected simple group containing SM rank four

minimality.interpretation: Rank below four cannot contain SU3 x SU2 x U1. In the rank-four census, SU(5) has the smallest Lie-algebra dimension.

z2_holonomy.centralizer: S(U3 x U2)=(SU3 x SU2 x U1)/Z6

one_generation.interpretation: All weak doublet states are Z2-odd and all weak singlets are Z2-even under P.

generation_temptation.obstruction: The set of spin structures is affine; no reference element is preferred without extra data. The equation 4-1=3 is therefore not yet a derivation.

single_simple_fiber.finding: SU(5) is the smallest-dimensional compact simple rank-four group in the standard Lie-family census and can contain the full SM-rank subgroup.

z2_breaking_to_sm.finding: P=diag(1,1,1,-1,-1) is an order-two SU(5) element with centralizer S(U3 x U2)=(SU3 x SU2 x U1)/Z6.

one_generation_branching.finding: The anomaly-free chiral package 10 + bar5 branches into exactly Q, u_c, e_c, d_c and L with standard hypercharges.

weak_doublet_parity_selector.finding: The same torsion holonomy makes Q and L odd while every weak singlet is even.

three_generations.finding: Four spin structures minus one chosen reference gives three, but spin structures form a torsor with no canonical zero. Selecting the excluded sector requires an independent geometric or dynamical rule.

masses_and_yukawa.finding: The construction fixes representation content and parity, not Yukawa matrices, symmetry-breaking scales or observed masses.

scientific_verdict.new_positive_result: A single minimal SU(5) fiber plus the existing Z2 torsion branch produces the SM gauge subgroup, one anomaly-free chiral generation, and a clean weak-doublet parity split without separate SU3/SU2 sector choices.
scientific_verdict.remaining_gaps: The choice 10+bar5 is not yet derived from the menu, three generations are not canonically selected, and no masses or Yukawa couplings follow.
scientific_verdict.next_gate: Search for a geometric invariant of the four spin structures that uniquely selects one reference sector and leaves three equivalent nonreference sectors, without using the observed generation count.
